data.gender_notes: Bilash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bilash is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindu name Vishv, which means 'all pervading'. Bilash is a name that is often given to a boy as a reminder of the presence of Lord Vishnu and the idea of victory and success. It is a powerful and godly name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. The name Bilash carries the meaning “Lord Vishnu, Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Bilash usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vishnu, victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
